policies.target_time: hit candle close (confirmation time), bar itself excluded from t0 search
policies.raw_event: first observed target hit from global trailing minimum; same-base recrosses excluded; episode-independent
policies.representative: first target_time per episode and type, chosen BEFORE quality or matching
policies.episode: target candle belongs to price segment ending at >=5% close drawdown from previously observed high
policies.episode_return: end close / segment start price - 1, percent; episode_range_pct is high/low range
policies.quality: same past360, baseline120 and futureH coverage thresholds for cases/controls; no longest-gap cutoff
policies.features: unchanged exact quantities: complete aggregation windows; exact endpoint returns; missing=NULL
policies.liquidity: matching-only observed-minute mean, coverage-gated; missing minutes not zero
policies.caution: partial controls are no OBSERVED surge, not proven absence; no inference or probability claims
